Auto-detect (recommended):
1. On the phone, enable Developer options → Wireless debugging.
2. Pair once with this PC if you never have.

With Auto-detect IP on, both the phone's address AND its wireless-debugging port — which Android randomises on every toggle/reboot — are discovered over the network (mDNS via avahi) on every launch. You never type either again.

Legacy fallback: if your phone has no Wireless debugging, plug in USB, press "Enable over USB" (adb tcpip 5555), then unplug.
